description: Reviewed feature flag profile for the closed alpha release. Values are expected deployment defaults; Ops may make audited runtime overrides only for incident response or an approved launch decision.

ai_generation_enabled.reason: Core alpha journey requires AI itinerary generation.

ai_repair_enabled.reason: Critical alpha journey includes validation and bounded repair.

copilot_enabled.reason: Existing advisory Copilot remains available as a support aid.

public_sharing_enabled.reason: Closed alpha includes read-only public sharing verification.

data_exports_enabled.reason: Private exports remain in scope only while smoke tests pass.

email_notifications_enabled.reason: Notification preferences and in-app/email paths are in scope.

notification_digests_enabled.reason: Digest behavior is part of notification noise control.

ops_dashboard_enabled.reason: Alpha recovery requires allowlisted Ops controls.

ai_model_serving_enabled.reason: Baseline model-serving metadata remains enabled without candidate rollout.

real_providers_enabled.reason: Real travel providers are disabled unless explicitly reviewed for a blocker.

calendar_sync_enabled.reason: Calendar sync is not part of closed alpha v1.

availability_search_enabled.reason: Booking-style availability search is excluded from alpha v1.

transport_search_enabled.reason: Transport booking-style search is excluded from alpha v1.

receipt_ocr_enabled.reason: OCR remains disabled; basic expense entry can still be used.

workspace_approvals_enabled.reason: Workspace approval workflows are outside the closed alpha scope.

policy_repair_enabled.reason: Experimental policy repair is excluded from normal alpha traffic.

web_push_enabled.reason: Browser push remains disabled until credentials and UX are separately reviewed.

offline_mode_enabled.reason: Offline mutations are excluded from alpha v1; normal online paths stay supported.

trip_workspace_consolidation_enabled.reason: Trip Workspace begins with internal and selected-alpha rollout after the frozen alpha v1 profile.

trip_workspace_overview_v2_enabled.reason: The operational overview follows the Trip Workspace staged rollout.

trip_workspace_next_best_action_enabled.reason: The next-action presentation follows the Trip Workspace staged rollout.

trip_workspace_mobile_navigation_enabled.reason: Mobile workspace navigation follows the Trip Workspace staged rollout.

trip_workspace_deep_link_v2_enabled.reason: Canonical deep-link emission follows the Trip Workspace staged rollout; legacy resolution remains available.

trip_workspace_shared_actions_enabled.reason: The shared action presentation follows the Trip Workspace staged rollout.

template_adaptation_enabled.reason: AI template adaptation is not part of the critical alpha path.

route_alternatives_enabled.reason: Route basics are in scope; alternative generation is deferred.

ai_fine_tuning_experiments_enabled.reason: No fine-tuned candidate rollout in closed alpha.

ai_adapter_inference_enabled.reason: Adapter inference is excluded from alpha v1.

ai_adapter_staging_enabled.reason: Adapter staging is excluded from alpha v1.

ai_shadow_evaluation_enabled.reason: Normal alpha users must not participate in shadow model evaluation.

ai_candidate_internal_rollout_enabled.reason: Candidate model responses are disabled for alpha users.

ai_candidate_allowlist_rollout_enabled.reason: Candidate model allowlist rollout is not part of alpha v1.

ai_candidate_percentage_rollout_enabled.reason: Percentage rollout is explicitly blocked for alpha v1.

ai_candidate_user_opt_in_enabled.reason: User opt-in candidate routing is excluded from alpha v1.

ai_automatic_guardrail_pause_enabled.reason: Automatic candidate guardrail pause is irrelevant while candidate traffic is disabled.
